主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. announced Tau Jeppesen, Senior Master Service Technician at Larry H. Miller Subaru in Boise, ID, as the winner of the 2021 American National Technician Competition. Jeppesen will compete in the Subaru World Technical Competition in Japan in 2022. The competition tested technicians in three vehicle skill groups, with challenges in precision measurement, engine performance, and body electrical. Participants were selected based on technical knowledge, FRFT scores, and ASE certifications. Jeppesen, with over seven years of experience, will receive a $1,500 cash prize and an all-expenses-paid trip to Japan. Second and third place winners also received prizes. The event took place at Subaru of America's U.S. headquarters in Camden, New Jersey. Thomas J. Doll, President and CEO, praised the participants and highlighted Jeppesen's achievements.
